# Models as Prediction Machines

## How to Convert Confusing Coefficients into Clear Quantities

This website hosts a replication package and detailed worked examples to accompany this article:

> "Rohrer JM, Arel-Bundock V. Models as Prediction Machines: How to Convert Confusing Coefficients Into Clear Quantities. Advances in Methods and Practices in Psychological Science. 2026;9(2). doi:10.1177/25152459261424825

You can find the published article [here](https://journals.sagepub.com/doi/10.1177/25152459261424825){target="_blank"}.

Worked Examples:

0. [Illustrating target quantities](examples/soep.html)

1. [Relationship Status and the Importance of Friends](examples/relationship.html)

2. [Friends by Chance](examples/deskmates.html)


Download the [full replication package as ZIP here.](assets/models_as_prediction_machines.zip)
